description: Synthetic reference conversations written for evaluation. No customer data. Human labels follow the MK Sales Score v1 rubric and the calibration rules in prompts.py. Add owner-reviewed sets (including real store audio transcripts, Marathi or Gujarati) as separate files outside Git.

clauses.text: Explain making charges as a percentage of metal value and why design work affects it.
Old gold is tested and valued at the day's rate before exchange.
All gold jewellery is BIS hallmarked; diamonds above the threshold carry a lab certificate.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Namaste ji, MK Jewels mein aapka swagat hai. Aaj kis occasion ke liye dekh rahe hain?
segments.translation_en: Hello, welcome to MK Jewels. What occasion are you shopping for today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Beti ki shaadi hai, bridal necklace chahiye, budget around 3 lakh.
segments.translation_en: It is my daughter's wedding, I need a bridal necklace, budget around 3 lakh.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Hamare paas 22 carat hallmark wale bridal sets hain. Making charges design ke hisaab se 12 se 18 percent hain kyunki handwork zyada hota hai.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Yeh wala design bahut sundar hai, iska weight kitna hai?

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Yeh 42 gram ka hai. Aapki beti ko kaunsa colour pasand hai, matching earrings bhi dikhaun?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Kal papa ke saath aayenge, tab final karenge.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Bilkul, main yeh design aapke liye hold kar deti hoon aur kal subah call karti hoon.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Good afternoon, welcome to MK Jewels. How can I help you today?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: I want a simple gold chain for daily wear. What is today's rate and how much are your making charges?

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Today's 22 carat rate is on the board. For plain chains the making charge is around 8 percent because there is less handwork.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Okay. Can I exchange my old gold ring?

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Yes, we test it in front of you and value it at today's rate, then adjust it against the new chain.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Good. Show me chains around 10 grams.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Haan boliye, kya dikhaun?
segments.translation_en: Yes, tell me, what should I show?

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Yeh diamond ring dusri dukaan mein 20 hazaar sasti mil rahi thi, aapka rate bahut zyada hai.
segments.translation_en: This diamond ring was 20 thousand cheaper at another shop, your price is too high.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Madam rate toh fix hai, isse kam nahi hoga.
segments.translation_en: Madam the rate is fixed, it will not go lower.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Certificate hai iska? Wahan toh IGI certificate de rahe the.
segments.translation_en: Does it have a certificate? They were giving an IGI certificate there.

segments.speaker: employee
segments.raw_text: Pata nahi, dekhna padega.
segments.translation_en: I don't know, I will have to check.

segments.speaker: customer
segments.raw_text: Theek hai, rehne dijiye, hum wahi le lenge.
segments.translation_en: Okay, leave it, we will buy it there.

segments.speaker: unknown
segments.raw_text: Haan ji dekhte hain

segments.speaker: unknown
segments.raw_text: theek hai
